answer_1.quote: We apply our method to two challenging tasks where LLMs are commonly utilized but their performance still lags behind humans: • Evaluation of LLM Outputs . LLMs are now regularly used to perform automatic evaluation of model responses, e.g., to user queries . ... • Constrained Text Generation. State-of-the-art LLMs struggle with constrained text generation tasks, e.g., the constraint of writing a story that should include several concepts.
answer_1.outputs: The paper evaluates outputs such as LLM-generated responses to multi-turn questions and constrained stories that must include specific concepts.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate BSM (and baselines) using the following four metrics. • LLM-Human Agreement (Ag). ... • Position Bias (PB). ... • Length Bias (LB). ... • Self-enhancement Bias (SB).

answer_3.quote: Please as an impartial judge and evaluate the quality of the stories provided by two AI assistants. Your evaluation should consider factors such as grammaticality, coherence, engagement, etc.

answer_4.quote: It consists of 2400 LLM responses and 3000 expert human judgements.
answer_4.guideline: Human evaluation involved expert judgements on which of two LLM responses was better or if it was a tie, based on criteria such as relevance, clarity, engagement, accuracy, and originality.
